sourcePackage.name: Mathlet
sourcePackage.note: Mathlet advertises 200 interactive math formula visualizations; its current repository also contains a reusable template renderer layer. AI Guru registers selected formula visualizations as visual teaching templates, not as copied video assets.

selectionPolicy.description: A Mathlet template may be selected only when its concept or visual grammar materially matches the lesson. Subject, grade, or domain alone is insufficient.
selectionPolicy.forbidden: Do not select a template merely because it is mathematics or the same grade.
